description: This Java source file defines the ReflectiveHandler class, which extends DefaultHandler to parse XML and instantiate objects via reflection, handling attributes, constructors, and nested elements for Android navigation components.

classes.name: ReflectiveHandler
classes.description: Main class for XML parsing and object instantiation using reflection, handling nested elements, attributes, and class loading.

classes.name: ReflectiveHandler.MyErrorHandler
classes.description: Handles SAX parsing errors and warnings, wrapping ErrorHandler.

classes.name: ReflectiveHandler.ElementInfo
classes.description: Represents an XML element with type, name, attributes, nested elements, and lazy evaluation of its value.

classes.name: ReflectiveHandler.Evaluator
classes.description: Abstract class for evaluating element values during parsing.

classes.name: ReflectiveHandler.LazyValue
classes.description: Manages lazy evaluation and caching of element values.

methods.name: getClassForName
methods.description: Resolves class from tag name using import lists and class loader.

methods.name: valueFor
methods.description: Converts string to object of specified type, using constructor with String parameter.

methods.name: findConstructor
methods.description: Finds a public constructor with the fewest parameters for a class.

methods.name: getConstructor
methods.description: Retrieves or caches the constructor for a class.

methods.name: getParameterNames
methods.description: Retrieves parameter names for a constructor based on annotations.

methods.name: getParameterValues
methods.description: Generates constructor argument values from attributes and nested elements.

methods.name: startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element, creating ElementInfo, resolving class, and setting evaluators.

methods.name: endElement
methods.description: Handles the end of an XML element, finalizing value, installing attributes and sub-elements.
